operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin UI v1 Wave 4, what the crew sees on an iPhone after this merges. Tap Customers in the bottom bar: one 48 px search field leads the page (16 px text, sticky under the top bar, no autofocus so the keyboard does not pop on every visit), results are ruled rows with name, phone, last visit and Open, each row with a phone has a More button holding Call, Text and (for lapsed customers) Win back, and one Sort select lists every sort the list supports. A customer profile's tabs are one scrolling strip of 48 px tabs; a tab whose read failed or is paused shows '?' and 'not checked', never 0 or 'none found'; a customer with no phone on file says history can't be looked up and offers no Retry. In Money, work orders on a phone are rows grouped by stage, each naming the order number, customer and status, with 'Blocked: parts', 'Emergency' or 'Overdue' in words; 'Move to' opens a short list of the next statuses and only the one you tap runs, so a slip moves nothing. Dispatch's ready queue and QC queue are rows with Assign and Check, which scroll their panel into view. Today's 'Open work order' now opens that exact work order. Nonstop Nick's counter lookup says 'Lookup failed. Not checked: this does not mean they are not a member.' when the read fails and 'Offline, not checked' when the phone is offline; 'No member found' appears only on a real not-found. Customer-facing SMS text is unchanged (admin-customer-copy-pins green). Tests: client/src/__tests__/admin-w4-desk.test.tsx (33 tests); the client folder green on the combined tree. Not device-tested: Nour's own look on his phone is owed after the deploy.
